notes: No online trophies. Cheats disable trophies and saving. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
sources: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements (egamers.io)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.description: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend. (Earn every other trophy.)
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap in order — story first, then side strands and collectibles, then the 100% completion grind for A Long Road, which is the last trophy most players earn. Expect around 200 hours at a relaxed pace.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion is the big endgame grind and the last stop before the platinum. The checklist is stricter than the individual trophies: 300 stunts (trophy asks 250), 70 of 80 Challenges (trophy asks 50), 200 of 277 vehicle models discovered (trophy asks 100), all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, 42 shooting-range gold medals and all 14 Top Fun drone-race locations. Track it in the game's own 100% checklist and mop up the biggest remaining category first.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are the game's jump and trick spots, scattered across Leonida. Work through them with a fast bike and keep a mental note of the ones you clear; the counter keeps climbing through normal play, and the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy. Revisit the stunt map markers after the story when you can travel freely.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit the shooting ranges and work through all 42 challenges, earning gold on each. Learn each challenge's scoring — accuracy and speed both matter — and repeat the ones you bronze until the gold threshold clicks. Ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush and nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through the optional mission "That's Where The Money Is" late in Chapter 4. Once open, rob five vaults and escape the police response each time — plan a fast getaway car nearby before you go in. All 8 vaults are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy is a natural step on the way there.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find the stranger missions marked around Leonida and finish eight full strands. Note that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's questlines have their own trophies and do NOT count toward this one, so pick eight other strands. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so sweep each region as the story opens it up.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in themed sets. Hunt three complete sets: search interiors, rooftops and out-of-the-way corners, and check the collection screen to see which cards of a set you still lack. Cards never disappear, so this is pure post-story cleanup if you like.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK spots are photo-style check-in points dotted around the map. Visit 100 of them and trigger the WAiNK interaction at each. Work region by region so you can see at a glance which areas are done, and combine the sweep with the map-exploration and vehicle-discovery trophies.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, drone races and the rest. If the trophy has not popped, check the activities menu for the type you have never touched and go try it; this is designed to pop naturally during a varied playthrough.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win twenty distinct races — each race event counts once, so vary the events rather than replaying one favourite. Pick a well-upgraded car for the class, learn the braking points on your first lap, and use the easier early races to build confidence before the tougher circuits.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level — cause enough chaos in a busy area — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. A fast car and a quiet hiding spot off the main roads make the escape far easier than outrunning helicopters in the open.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level ever dropping — move fast from one shop to the next and keep the heat on. Pick three shops close together, plan the route in advance, and use a quick getaway vehicle parked outside the first one.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Drive or enter 100 different vehicle models — simply getting into a new model counts as discovering it. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 models, so keep hopping into anything new you see. Rare models cluster in specific districts, so vary where you drive.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every named region of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. Drive the highways and back roads methodically, region by region, and check the map for dark patches you have never entered. Combine this with WAiNK spots and vehicle discovery to make one sweep do triple duty.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations in total; rob at least one operation per gang. Scout an operation first, hit it hard, and escape cleanly. Operations stay available after the story, so work through the gang list at your own pace.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; launder them through your contacts to turn them into clean cash. Keep laundering after every big score and the $250,000 total builds up on its own. This pairs naturally with bank-vault and shop robberies, which generate the bills in the first place.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone-race locations. Win at least one race at each. Learn each course's gates on a practice run, then race cleanly — cutting corners costs more time than it saves. All 14 locations count toward 100% completion as well.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, car parts and food all count. Don't grind it: buy gear you actually want as you play and it pops naturally. If you are close, a big vehicle upgrade is the fastest way to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app, for about $160,000 in total. Save up through story missions and robberies, then buy them in one sweep. Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Find ten vehicles you like, bring them to your garage and register each one in the Scooter Bros app. Any ten models count, so register the ones you already drive. This pairs well with Whip It Good — discover first, register your favourites second.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than yanking, and pick a quiet fishing spot where you can focus. Fishing challenges repeat, so a loss just means trying again with a better feel for the rhythm.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade and finish a full game on one of its machines. Pick the simplest cabinet first, learn its controls in the opening minute, and play through to the end screen. Arcades stay open after the story, so this is an easy one to grab whenever you pass one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditation spots are scattered across Leonida, and Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward it — that spot disappears after Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Meditate at every spot you find as you play, and clear the Chapter 1 balcony spot before finishing Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus during a firefight with at least five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. Pick a mission or shootout with grouped enemies, wait until they cluster, then activate and work through them quickly with headshots. If you only get four, retry the same fight.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly: get in, take the goods and get out without any alarm or witness raising the alert. Move quietly, avoid the staff's line of sight, and have your getaway ready before you start. If you are spotted, leave and try another store — the attempt itself costs nothing.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks patrol the roads of Leonida. Block one, crack it open, grab the cash and escape before the police close in. A heavy vehicle to ram it with and a fast car parked nearby for the getaway make this far smoother than improvising on foot.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's 80 small feats, from driving and combat to exploration. Complete any 50 of them — pick the easy ones first (driving distances, simple stunts, first-time activities) and let the counter climb as you play. 100% completion needs 70, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the mission Gone Fishing. It unlocks naturally as you play through the story — no special preparation needed, just keep following the mission markers.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 1. Before you close the chapter, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot for Positive Mental Attitude — it vanishes after Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the chapter's start as insurance.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, as you should for each chapter, and clear any meditation spots and stranger missions in the newly opened areas before moving on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 3. New districts open up here — use the chapter to sweep fresh WAiNK spots, vehicles and stunts while the story carries you through them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish every mission in Chapter 4. Late in this chapter the optional mission "That's Where The Money Is" unlocks bank-vault robberies — do it as soon as it appears so the vault grind can start.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the final mission. Keep a manual save before starting it, as the guide's roadmap advises, so you can replay the finale freely. After the credits, the whole open world stays available for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up in the story flow — follow the mission marker and complete its objectives as directed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heists reward preparation: stock up on ammo and armour before you start, and follow the crew's plan rather than improvising mid-job.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the mission Child's Play. It unlocks through the story — play the mission when it appears and complete its objectives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the mission Headliners. Story missions cannot be missed — keep playing the campaign and it will pop when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Expect a heavy airport firefight — bring a strong rifle, armour, and a fast car for the escape leg.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A large-scale operation — keep moving between cover, watch for flanking enemies, and save your heavy weapons for the final push.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand runs alongside the campaign — take his missions whenever they appear so the finale unlocks without backtracking.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Billy's final mission. Billy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks, so don't rely on it for that trophy — but do finish it for this one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Andy's final mission. Like Billy's and Tyrone's strands, Andy's does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — complete it for its own trophy and move on.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Randy's final mission. Work through Randy's strand as it appears in the story; the finale pops this trophy when it is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand, like Andy's and Billy's, does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — finish it for this trophy alone.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's directions to the hunting grounds, track the animal patiently, and take a clean shot — a scoped rifle and slow approach beat rushing in.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Story trophy: make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without clearance. Grab a plane on the tarmac, get airborne fast, and lose the wanted level once you are up.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and cause havoc. Steal one from a military area or during a mission that provides one, then enjoy the rampage — the trophy pops once you have spent enough time wrecking things in the tank.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game, following through on your throws. Any complete game counts — take your time, aim for the pocket, and finish all frames.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership milestone with your in-game partner: keep playing the duo activities together and this pops when your partnership hits its mark. It comes naturally from doing jobs and activities side by side.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Story trophy: make a significant choice at a story decision point. There is no wrong answer for the trophy — pick the option that fits your playthrough and the trophy pops when the choice lands.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. A simple moment trophy — sit, drink, take in the ocean, and it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front and out the other side, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big glass frontage, build speed on the approach, and smash through — the trophy pops on the exit.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something once, then succeed on the second try — the trophy rewards the comeback. Retry a mission or challenge you just failed and finish it; the pop follows the successful second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Stumble into one of Leonida's strangest encounters — the trophy's own description is the hint. Explore the odd corners of the map, investigate anything out of place, and this pops when the weird event triggers.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While driving, knock pedestrians over with a melee weapon swung from the vehicle — the bowling-pun trophy. Find a busy sidewalk, keep your speed low so you can aim the swing, and bowl them over one at a time until it pops.
